action_items: Non-blocking observation: The seeded 'HW Grade-Excluded Worksheet' homework doc (content_hwtest_gradeexcl) has no teacher_id field, so its resolved teacher_name is null and the banner falls back to 'Demo Class' (classroom_name) as the subtitle. Newer homework assignments store teacher_id correctly (verified with 'Testing' → 'Set by TTest'). If desired, backfill teacher_id on this legacy doc so the copy is consistent, or leave the current graceful fallback as-is.

Optional: The initial useState(true) for hasClassroom in Dashboard.jsx assumes classroom presence until ClassmatesSection reports otherwise. This is fine for real users but means a brief flash of the leaderboard slot before it collapses. Consider fetching classroom status server-side alongside the initial /wallet/quests/etc Promise.all to avoid the flash.
